The difference in calculated grain boundary strengthening, 28 MPa, closely corresponds with the experimentally measured difference in YS. Thus, it can be concluded that the grain refinement induced by the HSDT is the primary factor responsible for the observed increase in strength.
According to the Orowan equation, the precipitation strengthening contributed by Zr particles is calculated to be 4.7 MPa in the NHS-VK31 alloy and 8.9 MPa in the HS-VK31 alloy.

mechanisms.name: grain boundary pinning by Zr particles

evidence.section: 4.1. The formation mechanism of heterogeneous structure
evidence.quote: Fine Zr particles are effective in blocking the migration of both LAGB and HAGB, thus severely inhibiting the DRX process both CDRX and DDRX [34] . Additionally, Zr particles are known to pin grain boundaries, thereby impeding grain growth during the grain growth process.

mechanisms.name: geometrically necessary dislocation and back stress accumulation

evidence.quote: The generation of back stress not only contributes to improving the strain compatibility of the material but also enhances its strength and work hardening ability.

During deformation of the HS-VK31 alloy, the more numerous and finer grains in fine-grained regions created favorable conditions for the activation of < c + a > dislocations, which were easily decomposed into partial dislocations ( < c > dislocations and < a > dislocations) and stacking faults.

mechanisms.name: stress concentration alleviation by dispersed Zr particles

evidence.quote: the more dispersed and finer Zr particles in HS-VK31 alloy could effectively alleviate stress concentration, preventing the deterioration of ductility.
